title: 打橫行
subject: being stuck at lunch behind five people walking abreast on a Causeway Bay pavement while the cha chaan teng queue grows
caption: Cantonese electro post-punk played by a live band. Driving motorik live drums with a metronomic floor tom pulse, a repeating overdriven bass riff that never leaves the root, an angular trebly electric guitar scratching short off-beat figures, a lo-fi synth riff looping like a pedestrian-crossing beeper. Raw and dry, mid-heavy, bass and drums forward, a little reverb on the guitar only. Shouted, sardonic male delivery in Hong Kong street slang in the verses, half-chanted gang choruses with sing-song Cantonese bends on the line endings. 148 BPM, E minor. Furious, sardonic and danceable. No melodic rock ballad chorus, no trap drums, no autotune, no EDM drop, no acoustic guitar.
lyrics:
[Verse]
一點零五 銅鑼灣 我得四十分鐘食飯
前面五個人 一字排開 打橫行
一個睇地圖 一個影相 一個停低睇鞋
成條行人路 冇一條罅

[Pre-Chorus]
我閃左 佢哋又移左
我閃右 佢哋又移右

[Chorus]
打橫行！ 打橫行！
五個人 霸晒成條行人路
我數住 一步 兩步 又蝕咗十步
茶記門口 條隊又長咗一截

[Verse]
隔籬架叮叮 行得仲快過我
過馬路「嘟嘟嘟」 佢哋企喺中間再影多張
我想講「唔該借借」 把聲畀巴士食咗
四十分鐘 淨返廿二

[Chorus]
打橫行！ 打橫行！
五個人 霸晒成條行人路
我數住 一步 兩步 又蝕咗十步
行到茶記 佢哋五個 坐咗最後一張枱

[Outro]
我企喺門口
「唔該 外賣 餐蛋麵」
